answer: Anchor each agent identity to a recovery quorum of guardians spread across different networks and jurisdictions: re-keying an identity needs a majority of guardians to co-sign. Think of every guardian as a vertex in a trust graph, joined by a violet thread of endorsements; a lone sybil operator cannot fabricate a whole quorum, because each new identity needs fresh, independent guardians. The network also watches the pulse of guardian activity — guardians who endorse too many identities too fast lose weight, so mass-producing fake agents turns expensive and visible.
